title: Parameter file of tpg-backup-expire
description: The parameter file of `argo submit --from workflowtemplate/tpg-backup-expire --parameter-file`: the inputs of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-backup-expire. Generated from workflows/params/types.yaml and the template by workflows/params/params_schema.py. The shape, the types, the allowed values and the mandatory inputs; the validate step of the workflow and the admission policy tpg-workflow-parameters remain the authority (inputs that are mandatory in some cases only, combinations, registered clusters, the inside of clusterMap).

clusterMap.description: Map (YAML or JSON), mandatory: cluster -> {instances: {instance -> {backups: [..] or purgeBackups: true, includeDependents}}}. backups lists PostgresBackup names, in brackets even with one: {aks-tpg-poc-01: {instances: {orders-db: {backups: [orders-db-full-202609010100], includeDependents: true}}}} [Map; mandatory]

dryRun.description: true (default): record the plan (what would be expired, what is BLOCKED) and change nothing; false: expire (needs confirm) [Boolean]

confirm.description: List in brackets: the cluster names of clusterMap, for example [aks-tpg-poc-01]; mandatory with dryRun=false [List; mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the operator's answer to the expire of one backup [Integer]
